question: Why do ovarian cycles not appear in nursing mothers for several months after birth ?:

options.opa: For stress and lack of sleep associated with breastfeeding.
options.opb: Because there are low levels of FSH and LH.
options.opc: Because there are high levels of oxytocin.
options.opd: By saving iron that is derived from breastfeeding.
options.ope: Because there are high levels of progesterone.
